description: Tag frames, stories or text with an XML tag (Tag Element / Tag Frame / Tag Text), autotag frames and tables with the default tags (Tags panel > Autotag), untag frames (Tags panel > Untag), or add every untagged story and graphic to the structure (Structure pane menu > Add Untagged Items)

parent.description: Parent element for newly tagged frames (default: the root). An XML element: its id (from list_xml_structure), its path of child indexes from the root element ([] is the root), the first element an XPath expression matches, or selection: true for the element selected in the Structure pane (or the selected tagged item). Give exactly one

path.description: Child indexes from the root, e.g. [0, 2] is the third child of the root's first child

selection.description: Use the element selected in the Structure pane

xpath.description: XPath expression evaluated from the root element, e.g. //article[@id="a1"]

tables.description: Tables to autotag, by text frame and table index

frameId.description: Id of the text frame holding the table

index.description: Index of the table in the frame

tag.description: Tag name for action tag (created if missing)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true. A text frame stands for its story

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

text.description: Tag a range of text (Tag Text): characters start to end (inclusive, 0-based) of the story in a text frame; give frameId, start and end. An untagged story is first tagged with the default story tag, as InDesign does

end.description: Last character index in the story

frameId.description: Id of a text frame of the story

start.description: First character index in the story

name: tag_xml_content
title: Tag XML Content
